item.title: ‘MASSIVE HONOUR,’ SAYS NANCY AS HE IS NAMED CELTIC BOSS
item.description: WILFRIED NANCY has been appointed new manager at Celtic on a two-and-a-half year contract and will take up his post tomorrow. The 48-year-old Frenchman will take over from Martin O’Neill who will bring down the curtain on his eight-game interim period against Dundee at Parkhead this evening. item.description: CELTIC 1 DUNDEE 0 DAIZEN MAEDA gave Martin O’Neill the perfect leaving present with the only goal of the game against Dundee at Parkhead this evening.
